content.text:
# Sprint Ticket: Password Reset Recovery Link Expiry

## Title
Password Reset: Recovery Links Expire After 15 Minutes

## Description
Propose that password reset recovery links expire after 15 minutes of issuance. This ensures security while maintaining usability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] When a user requests a password reset, a unique link is generated and sent via email.
- [ ] The link expires exactly 15 minutes after generation.
- [ ] After expiration, the link becomes invalid and cannot be used to reset the password.
- [ ] Users who attempt to use an expired link receive a clear error message: “The reset link has expired.”
- [ ] System logs indicate when links are generated and expire (for audit purposes).

## Open Questions
- Should users be notified via email or in-app message if their recovery link expires?
- What should happen if the user re-initiates password reset after expiration? Should they receive a new link or be prompted to request one again?
- Is there a need for an option to extend the expiry time (e.g., for users who may have missed the link)?
- How will this affect existing users with expired links in their history?

---

*Note: This is a proposal. No implementation claims are made.*

content.text:
# Ticket: Implement Password Reset Flow

## Description  
Define user story and acceptance criteria for a password reset feature that allows users to reset their password via email, with secure token-based verification. This is a new feature from scratch.

## Acceptance Criteria  
- [ ] User receives an email with a unique, time-limited token upon request.  
- [ ] Token must be validated against the user’s account and expiration window.  
- [ ] Password reset form accepts new password and reconfirms it (e.g., same field twice).  
- [ ] System rejects invalid tokens or expired tokens.  
- [ ] User receives confirmation email after successful reset.  

## Sprint Planning Context  
- **Assigned to**: Backend team  
- **Estimate**: 3 days  
- **Priority**: Medium urgency  

## Assumptions & Open Questions  
- No existing password reset functionality exists — this is a new implementation.  
- Security standards (e.g., JWT, OAuth2) are not specified — standard secure email + token-based reset will be used.  
- No evidence of compliance requirements or user flow constraints beyond basic email verification and token validation.

> *Note: No claims about code changes, test results, or completed work.*
